relations: As the man walks away, his silhouette shrinks, with his head settling lower and feet rising within the frame.
His legs alternate in a steady stride, lifting and planting feet while arms remain close to his sides.
The floor reflection lengthens into a bright streak trailing behind him as he proceeds deeper into the haze.
Fog density and backlight intensity waver subtly around his moving figure, shifting the overhead beam's position.
caption: The video captures a backlit silhouette of a man in a jacket and trousers, seen from behind, moving through a dark, fog-filled space. A broad diffuse glow burns to his right while a shaft of light falls from above, and a faint mirror of his feet shimmers on the floor. He is mid-stride throughout, his legs cycling through a steady walking gait as one foot lifts and swings forward, then plants, alternating repeatedly. His arms hang close to his sides, shifting only slightly with his stride. As he proceeds, his figure gradually shrinks within the frame, the edge of his head settling lower and his feet rising, consistent with him walking away from the viewpoint into the haze. The overhead beam and the side glow shift subtly in position and intensity, the fog density wavering around him. The reflection beneath him lengthens into a bright streak trailing across the floor as the sequence advances.
